Built here first

Starting at UNN, Nsukka.

We're not launching everywhere at once. Kayka starts on the one campus we know best, sold by students who understand the budget and what a hostel playlist actually needs to survive.

As the first run sells through: reinvest, expand the lineup, carry the same standard to the next campus.
